user.title: Sign in to iCloud
user.description:
CapsPlan reads your medications from the iCloud account that CapsPlan syncs with (CapsPlan → Settings → Backups → iCloud sync).

1. Open [the CapsPlan sign-in page]({sign_in_url}) and sign in with your Apple ID.
2. Copy the token the page shows and paste it here.

The token only gives access to CapsPlan's own data. It stays in Home Assistant.

data_description.web_auth_token: Shown on the CapsPlan sign-in page after you signed in.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The iCloud sign-in has expired. Open [the CapsPlan sign-in page]({sign_in_url}), sign in again and paste the new token.

data_description.web_auth_token: Shown on the CapsPlan sign-in page after you signed in.

error.invalid_auth: The token is not valid (anymore). Sign in again on the sign-in page and paste the new token right away. Accounts with Advanced Data Protection cannot sign in, see the documentation.
error.cannot_connect: iCloud could not be reached. Try again later.

abort.already_configured: This Apple ID is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: This token belongs to a different Apple ID.
